description: Couloir de bus SAEIV is a dataset listed in DataHub Métropole de Bordeaux open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Bordeaux Métropole. Dictionnaire Public Le réseau de transports urbains de la Métropole Bordelaise (TBM) est le réseau de transports collectifs (tramway, bus, navettes fluviales et vélos en libre-service) de Bordeaux Métropole. Un délégataire de service public met en oeuvre les décisions de La Métropole et exploite ce réseau. Coverage: Bordeaux Métropole. The portal files it under Transports/mobilité. Its keywords are transports, réseau, vcub, bateaux, batcub, physique. The portal shows 448 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2014/05/Licence_Ouverte.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-datahub-bordeaux-metropole-fr-portal.
